job_description:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Come shape the future of our industry by bringing Artificial Intelligence capabilities to life!

Digital Core IT is actively looking for an AI Capabilities and Ops Associate Director to lead a technical team building and supporting solutions that improve performance and reliability of processes and systems in pharma. This role is perfect for someone with a passion for artificial intelligence and a solid background in DevOps practices, aimed at delivering high-quality solutions rapidly and effectively. If you thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, and are skilled at leveraging both AI and DevOps to solve complex problems, then this is your opportunity to make significant impact. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and the impact it can have across an entire industry? Are you a change agent who can influence organizations? If so, bring YOUR skills and talents to the Lilly team where you’ll have the chance to create an impact on the lives of patients!

What You'll Be Doing:

Team Leadership and Program Delivery: Manage and mentor a team of AI engineers and DevOps specialists. Oversee the design, development, and deployment of AI-infused software solutions, maintaining alignment with our company’s vision and purpose.

AI-Driven Development Strategy: Lead the strategic adoption of AI technologies within our DevOps frameworks, ensuring seamless integration and operational excellence. Introduce AI tools and algorithms that enhance automation in testing, deployment, and infrastructure management.

Innovation in Automation and Processes: Utilize AI to streamline workflows, improve the CI/CD pipeline, and optimize cloud infrastructure management. Ensure our DevOps practices incorporate the latest in AI advancements to enhance speed and quality.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, software developers, and external stakeholders to ensure that our DevOps strategy integrates effectively across all phases of development and supports overarching business goals.

Quality Assurance and Performance Metrics: Implement robust testing frameworks and monitor system performance continuously. Use AI-driven analytics to anticipate problems and deliver solutions proactively.

Ethical AI Use and Compliance: Promote ethical practices in the use of AI within DevOps, adhering to all regulatory and compliance guidelines, and ensuring the privacy and security of data across all platforms.

How You Will Succeed:

Analytical and Strategic Problem Solving: Employ critical thinking to navigate complex challenges, leveraging knowledge of organizational needs and solid technical skills to deliver innovative solutions.

Technical Proficiency and Innovation: Drive different thinking and propose innovative solutions working with Lilly and vendor partners. Combine your knowledge of AI technologies with a robust understanding of DevOps principles to drive the development and optimization of our products.

Effective Communication: Articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to a diverse range of stakeholders, fostering understanding and strategic alignment.

Leadership and Team Building: Inspire and lead your team towards achieving technological excellence, promoting an environment of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Commitment to Learning: Continuously update your knowledge on the latest in AI and DevOps fields, ensuring that our practices and tools remain at the forefront of technological advancements.

What You Should Bring:

Leadership Capabilities: Proven track record in leading cross-functional teams and driving complex large technical programs and enterprise capability implementations to successful completion.

Background in AI and DevOps: Demonstrated experience in managing and integrating AI within DevOps environments. Understanding of machine learning, neural networks, and their practical applications in automation and optimization.

Technical Skills: Prior experience in programming languages and technologies relevant to AI and DevOps, such as Python, Ruby, and Java. Familiarity with AI frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch,) DevOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins,) and cloud environments such as Azure and AWS.

Strategic Vision and Tactical Execution: Ability to develop strategic visions for AI-powered products and ensure their effective execution through agile DevOps practices.

Ethical and Regulatory Knowledge: Commitment to ethical AI development and a strong understanding of compliance and security protocols in software development in regulated industries.

Your Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
• Experience in Cloud environments such as AWS or Azure
• 5+ years of technology program and product leadership experience with expertise in industry standard methodologies.
• 2+ years of experience in working with AI technologies and tools, such as natural language processing (NLP), generative AI (LLMs,) machine learning algorithms, deep learning, etc.

Additional Preferences:
• Previous experience delivering large organizational change tied to technology implementations
• DevOps, DevSecOps and ITIL certifications
• Scaled Agile, Agile, and Scrum certifications
• Previous direct employee leadership experience
• Cloud environment certifications in Azure and AWS
• Previous technical program leadership in regulated industries

Additional Information:

AI - Innovation, Delivery and Business Development Leader (Consumer & Retail Focus)

SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, is a U.S. based, data science consulting firm specializing in building industry-specific, artificial intelligence (AI) technologies.

The practice brings together several key capabilities to develop and transform our clients' organizations through AI & Data Strategy. We are looking for an AI - Innovation, Delivery and Business Development Leader to support the vision, strategy, and execution of our Artificial Intelligence go-to-market initiatives within the Consumer-Packaged Goods, Retail, and adjacent sectors.

Join us to expand your technical career through the lens of professional services and consulting and help create novel solutions to advance your data science & AI career.

Recruiting for this role ends on 6/30/2024.

Work You'll Do

As the AI - Innovation, Delivery and Business Development Leader you will be responsible for helping to identify, advocate, and execute Deloitte's interests across consumer-focused organizations, with a specific focus on novel approaches in Generative AI, natural language processing, computer vision for imaging & autonomous systems, smart factory, and other state-of-the-art capabilities. The individual is responsible for building the relationship between Deloitte, our alliance partners, and the client, helping architect novel AI solutions and capabilities to generate client impact, as well as planning and penetrating target technology areas and supporting AI integration and deployment.

The consumer industry is focused on serving the changing consumer, who has rapidly evolving needs, behaviors and preferences for products, services, and experiences. The candidate will work with senior leaders within Deloitte and our alliance partners to craft and execute go-to-market strategies. The practice has a proven track record serving large, market-leading organizations in the private and public sectors, successfully delivering high-quality, novel and complex projects, offering deep domain, R&D, and scientific capabilities.

The Team

Our practice is focused on organizations making strategic choices to unlock new growth, elevate the customer experience, drive innovation, and enable competitive advantage. Deloitte's services and solutions provide actionable insights that enable our clients to formulate near- and long-term strategies to address their most pressing issues and provide clear path for implementation

Made up of experienced AI strategists, data scientists, and AI engineers, they serve as trusted advisors to executives, helping them understand and evaluate new and essential areas for AI investment and identify unique opportunities to transform their businesses.

Basic Qualifications
• Master's or Ph.D. preferred in STEM field, high proficiency in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning
• 5+ years of industry experience in Consumer Products, Packaged Goods or Retail
• 3+ years of experience and a proven track record in shaping, selling, and delivering work in Artificial Intelligence
• 5+ years of previous experience traditional ML and deep learning techniques, AI integration strategy, and deployment tools and environments
• 5+ years of previous experience in managing technical or solutions teams and delivering complex AI/ML and analytics workloads
• 3+ years of experience in business and relationship development, proposal management and management of enterprise accounts or technical solutions in complex organizations
• 3+ years of experience utilizing NVIDIA GPU hardware and SDK packages
• Live within commuting distance to one of Deloitte's consulting offices
• Ability to travel 10% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications
• 6+ years of experience and excellent knowledge of digital tools and services, cloud environments, automation, and operational AI

Job Title: Lead AI Researcher & Founding Team Member

Location: Palo Alto

Company Overview

EQE is a pioneering AI research studio committed to advancing the frontiers of artificial intelligence through an interdisciplinary approach. Situated at the convergence of neuroscience, artificial intelligence, and psychology, EQE is dedicated to developing emotionally intelligent AGI by leveraging brain-inspired cognitive models, particularly Spiking Neural Networks, and Neuromorphic computing. We firmly believe that this approach not only represents the most promising path to AGI but also holds the key to safeguarding the essence of humanity and the future of our species.

Job Description

EQE is seeking a highly skilled and visionary Founding Team Member to play a foundational role in shaping our organization and driving forward our mission of achieving emotionally intelligent, human-centered AGI. As a key member of the founding team, you will help lead our research efforts, define our strategic direction, and contribute to building a culture of innovation and excellence.

Key Responsibilities

● Research Leadership: Lead and oversee groundbreaking research projects aimed at developing our AGI system using genetic algorithms using artificial evolution to design spiking neural network architectures, and neuromorphic computing.

● Strategic Vision: Define and articulate the long-term research vision and roadmap aligned with EQE's mission of achieving human-centered AI. Identify key research areas, opportunities, and challenges, and develop strategies to address them effectively.

● Team Management: Provide mentorship, guidance, and technical leadership to a team of talented AI researchers, fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, and excellence. Manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables to ensure successful project execution.

● Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including neuroscientists, psychologists, computer scientists, and engineers to integrate insights from diverse disciplines into AI research projects. Forge partnerships with academic institutions, industry collaborators, and research organizations to advance our research agenda.

● Innovation and Experimentation: Encourage a culture of innovation, curiosity, and experimentation within the research team. Explore novel approaches, methodologies, and techniques to advance the state-of-the-art in emotionally intelligent AI systems.

● Publication and Thought Leadership: Drive the dissemination of research findings through high-impact publications in top-tier conferences and journals. Represent EQE as a thought leader in the field of AI research through conference presentations, keynote speeches, and participation in industry events.

Qualifications

● Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Neuroscience, Psychology, or related field.

● Proven track record of conducting cutting-edge research in AI, with a focus on Spiking Neural Networks, Neuromorphic computing, or related areas.

● Strong leadership skills with experience in leading and mentoring research teams. ● Deep understanding of brain-inspired cognitive models and SNNs.

● Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

● Publication record in top-tier conferences and journals in AI and related fields.

Benefits

● Class A equity ownership in the company as a founding team member. ● Industry-best salary compensation

● Opportunity to shape the future of AI as a foundational member of EQE. ● Access to cutting-edge resources and technology.

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The EY Public Policy function focuses on the public policy and regulatory issues that affect EY’s businesses. Our dialogue with policymakers, regulators, investors, and other stakeholders helps inform our views and actions as we navigate the complexity of operating across the globe in over 150 countries.

The opportunity

One year contract, with potential for extension, to work in EY’s Global Public Policy (GPP) team. The EY Public Policy function works to advance EY’s strategic objectives in a number of areas, including public policy and regulatory matters related to audit and assurance; sustainability; financial services; technology (artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data and cloud, and other policy matters); and geopolitics. This Assistant Director role will support the Public Policy team’s work focusing on AI and digital technology, working with both global and areas teams.

Your key responsibilities

As Assistant Director, you will work with other members of the GPP team and with other EY colleagues to help advance EY’s AI-related public policy priorities primarily through contributing to the production of written materials (such as AI thought-leadership papers, Points of View, talking points and presentations), and managing these resources. You will also work with the Brand, Marketing and Communications colleagues to help ensure that public messaging which touches on AI public policy matters is attuned to the latest developments and at the highest level of quality. These materials will be used both for EY leaders’ internal meetings and meetings with key external parties, including policymakers, regulators, legislators, standard-setters, trade association members, and other stakeholders. The role will provide you with opportunities to develop subject matter expertise on important matters for EY, as well as to work collaboratively with EY experts from multiple service lines and geographies.

You will manage your own portfolio of work, in close collaboration with the GPP Assistant Director of Technology & Geopolitics and overseen by GPP’s Global Digital Technology Policy Leader, AI Ethics and Regulatory Leader and the Global Public Policy AI Working Group.

Skills and attributes for success
• Ability to produce high quality written content to inform and share insights with external stakeholders and share EY’s POV with respect to AI policy related matters
• Strong English writing skills, including the ability to tailor communications to different internal and external audiences
• An understanding of and interest in global public policy matters, particularly with respect to AI and related technology regulatory developments.
• Ability to identify and analyze public policy and regulatory developments, put them into context and identify/communicate key concerns and insight
• Ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects and tasks concurrently
• Strategic thinking skills and experience addressing complex challenges
• Agility to work with agility and pace under tight deadlines, and to pivot to emerging issues and tasks of an urgent nature
• Experience of working in complex international organisations, such as to navigate across EY’s service lines and functions

To qualify for the role you must have
• 5+ years experience working on topics related to AI/digital/emerging technology matters
• Excellent, professional writing skills (English) and experience of producing high quality, professional written materials (including on topics of a regulatory, legal/technical and business nature). Knowledge and experience of writing about public policy-related issues related to AI and/or related digital technologies (share a recent example)
• Ability to ‘translate’ and communicate clearly about technical matters, to non-expert audiences
• Strong analytical skills. Ability to synthesize complex information from various sources
• Excellent Project Management and organizational skills.
• Commercial mindset, understanding and interest in the commercial and other operational and strategic business implications of AI and digital changes . An understanding of – or a willingness to understand – EY’s business and the potential impact of AI regulation on EY’s business
• The ability to work in a complex organization with different subject matter experts, as well as to work as a member of a team, including by collaborating, being transparent, taking initiative, and working virtually if and as appropriate
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities effectively and meeting deadlines on schedule. Ability to deal with unexpected or last-minute requests, while executing more regular tasks and projects.
• Strong team player and effective communicator. Experience of working effectively in a virtual/semi-virtual team environment.
• Demonstrable integrity at all times, and exercise good judgement and discretion with sensitive information
• Proactive and energetic, can-do mindset, able to work with high degree of independence
• Candidate should be willing to consider a 12-months contract. Opportunities to extend the contract may arise during the contract period.

Ideally, you’ll also have
• Interest in geopolitics and world affairs
• Keen interest in expanding your knowledge on AI and digital technology topics
• Experience summarizing technology papers for quick dissemination (e.g. social media posts)
• MS Office, (PowerPoint, Excel a priority), and other technology skills
• Professional-level knowledge of 1 or more additional languages (in addition to English)

Education:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent university degree is required.

Experience:

Minimum 5 years’ work experience (or graduate degree plus 3 years’ work experience)

Certification Requirements:

NLA

What we look for

We’re looking for an experienced, high-energy, self-starting individual who embraces change, technology and innovation and has a passion for helping us Build a Better Working World.

What we offer

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The salary range for this job in most geographic locations in the US is $100,400 to $182,200. The salary range for New York City Metro Area and Washington State is $120,500 to $207,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
• Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
• Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Are you an AI/ML Engineer who loves to build and implement innovative solutions that create value at scale? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Senior AI/ML engineer role at Carlyle.

The EY Public Policy function focuses on the public policy and regulatory issues that affect EY’s businesses. Our dialogue with policymakers, regulators, investors, and other stakeholders helps inform our views and actions as we navigate the complexity of operating across the globe in over 150 countries.

The opportunity

One year contract, with potential for extension, to work in EY’s Global Public Policy (GPP) team. The EY Public Policy function works to advance EY’s strategic objectives in a number of areas, including public policy and regulatory matters related to audit and assurance; sustainability; financial services; technology (artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data and cloud, and other policy matters); and geopolitics. This Assistant Director role will support the Public Policy team’s work focusing on AI and digital technology, working with both global and areas teams.

As Assistant Director, you will work with other members of the GPP team and with other EY colleagues to help advance EY’s AI-related public policy priorities primarily through contributing to the production of written materials (such as AI thought-leadership papers, Points of View, talking points and presentations), and managing these resources. The role will provide you with opportunities to develop subject matter expertise on important matters for EY, as well as to work collaboratively with EY experts from multiple service lines and geographies.

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer, Generative AI Infrastructure to help us build the foundations of our AI capabilities. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, whether that’s building large-scale distributed training clusters, or deploying LLMs on GPU instances for real-time applications and decisioning systems, or supporting cutting-edge AI research and development, all in our public cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with our cloud and container infrastructure teams as well as our world-class team of AI researchers to design and implement key capabilities. Examples of projects you will work on:
• Deploy a thousand-node training cluster optimizing storage and networking stack, with tightly coupled training pipelines to take advantage of multiple parallelism strategies, in our public cloud.
• Design and build fault-tolerant infrastructure to support long-running large-scale training tasks reliably despite failure of individual nodes, using containers and check-pointing libraries.
• Design and build run-time infrastructure for serving large ML models such as LLMs and FMs in our public cloud.
• Build infrastructure for deploying search indexes and embeddings in vector databases that will work closely with the rest of our capabilities.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 6 years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing
• At least 6 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
• At least 1 year of experience with HPCs, vector embedding, or semantic search technologies
• At least 1 years of experience building, scaling, and optimizing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks

• Master's or Doctoral degree in Computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.
• Background in machine learning with experience in large scale training and deployment of deep neural nets and/or transformer architectures.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or Pytorch, Lightning, Mosaic ML etc.
• Ability to move fast in an environment with ambiguity at times, and with competing priorities and deadlines.
• Experience at tech and product-driven companies/startups preferred.
• Ability to iterate rapidly with researchers and engineers to improve a product experience while building the foundational capabilities.
• Familiarity with deploying large neural network models in demanding production environments.
• Experience with building GPU clusters in the public cloud with tightly-coupled storage and networking.
